caseNameFull: Hogge v. Johnson, City Manager of Hampton, Virginia

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari denied. Mr. Justice Brennan would grant certiorari and, as in Colorado Springs Amusements, Ltd. Y. Rizzo, infra, this page, remand case for determination of petitioners’ constitutional contentions giving appropriate, but not necessarily conclusive, weight to our summary dispositions.
